name: data.gouv.fr API
tagline: French government open data catalog and dataset API
description: REST API for France's national open data portal (data.gouv.fr), providing programmatic access to datasets, reuses, organizations, and related catalog metadata published by public bodies.

auth.details: Optional API key via X-API-KEY header for authenticated writes and higher limits; many read endpoints work without auth

use_cases: search French open government datasets by keyword
fetch metadata and download URLs for a dataset
list organizations publishing open data on data.gouv.fr
discover reuses (applications) built on French open datasets
